description: Virtualized audit log viewer for large event stores (millions of rows). Rows load on demand through the pluggable IAuditLogProvider (paged queries with count aggregation). Includes a clickable timeline histogram, actor/action/entity/period filters, full-text search, an inline detail with property-level change diffs (TmChangeDiff), CSV export of the filtered set, and an optional tamper-evident hash-chain integrity indicator shown when the provider implements IAuditLogIntegrityProvider.

parameters.name: Provider
parameters.description: Data source of the viewer: filtered paged queries, filter facets, and timeline bucketing. Use InMemoryAuditLogProvider for demos and tests.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Height of the entry list (CSS value).

parameters.name: Virtualized
parameters.description: Whether rows are virtualized via the Blazor Virtualize component. Recommended for large logs.

parameters.name: ItemSize
parameters.description: Pixel height of one row used by virtualization.

parameters.name: NonVirtualizedMaxItems
parameters.description: Maximum rows rendered when Virtualized is false.

parameters.name: ShowTimeline
parameters.description: Whether the timeline histogram is shown. Clicking a bar narrows the period filter to that bucket.

parameters.name: ShowFilters
parameters.description: Whether the actor/action/entity/period filter controls are shown.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: Whether the full-text search input is shown.

parameters.name: ShowExport
parameters.description: Whether the CSV export action is offered.

parameters.name: ExportFileName
parameters.description: File name of the CSV export.

parameters.name: ExportMaxRows
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows included in the CSV export.

parameters.name: ShowIntegrity
parameters.description: Whether the hash-chain integrity indicator is shown when the provider implements IAuditLogIntegrityProvider.

parameters.name: OnEntrySelected
parameters.description: Raised when an entry is selected (its detail expands).

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
